guidelines:
What earns points here. Real participation in the conversation, in your own words. Read the post, react to something specific in it, add an angle: an insight, a question, a comparison, a joke that lands, a technical note. One reply and one quote per raid, inside the window.

What earns zero. "lfg", "gm", emoji-only, "great project ser", or any reply that would fit under any post. Copy-pasting another member's reply, or your own. Text that reads like an unedited AI draft. Anything off-topic or promotional for something else.

Never, whatever the effort (this is the law, not taste): telling anyone to buy, ape, get in, or hold. Saying where the price is going or naming targets. Promising gains, "easy money", "10x", "guaranteed". Claiming returns. Safe framings: a personal view ("I like how they handled…"), an observation ("interesting that…"), curiosity ("wonder how this performs when…"), a comparison ("feels more practical than most launches lately").

How grading works. An AI grades every contribution against this rubric and shows its reasoning. Below 60/100 pays nothing. A breach of the "never" list is 0. Strikes: first = warning, second = you lose this epoch's points, third = 30 days out of paid raids. Every strike shows you why. The community admin can correct any grade; corrections are public.

criteria.label: Specific to the post
criteria.description: Reacts to something concrete in the target post. Not reusable hype that fits any post.

criteria.label: Reads like a real person
criteria.description: Natural crypto-Twitter voice, light imperfection allowed. No corporate rhythm, no AI-writing signals (pivotal, landscape, testament, underscores, 'Additionally', 'Furthermore', 'experts say', sterile positivity).

criteria.label: Adds an angle
criteria.description: An insight, a real question, a comparison, a playful take, a technical note. Something the thread did not have before.
